cases.rule: a-today: a hyphen join is a token boundary, so it matches
a-today: an underscore join is a token boundary, so it matches
a-today: a letter after the id extends the word, so no match
a-today: a letter before the id extends the word, so no match
a-today: a digit after the id extends the token, so no match
a-today: a lower-case id of ordinary length matches case-insensitively
b-word-id: a lower-case word id in running prose is not a match
b-word-id: an all-upper-case word id is a match
b-word-id: a path segment between slashes is a match
b-word-id: a path segment followed by a dot is a match
b-word-id: a letter after the id extends the word, so no match
b-word-id mixed case: an all-upper-case form of a mixed-case word id is a match, reported as the stored id
b-word-id mixed case: a path segment spelled exactly as the stored id is a match
b-word-id mixed case: a path segment in lower case is not a match for a mixed-case id
b-word-id mixed case: the stored spelling in running prose is not a match
b-word-id mixed case: the lower-case word in running prose is not a match
b-word-id path segment at end: the last segment, at the end of the text, is a match
b-word-id path segment at end: a space after the segment is a boundary, so it matches
b-word-id path segment at end: a mixed-case id as stored, at the end of the text, is a match
b-word-id path segment at end: a letter after the id extends the word, so no match
c-short-id: an all-upper-case short id is a match
c-short-id: a lower-case short id is not a match
c-short-id: inside a hyphen-joined upper-case and digit run is not a match
c-short-id: right edge only, a hyphen then a digit after the id (nothing joined on the left) is not a match
c-short-id: left edge only, an upper-case letter and a hyphen before the id (token ends right after it) is not a match
c-short-id: left edge only, a digit and a hyphen before the id (token ends right after it) is not a match
c-short-id: left edge only, an upper-case letter and a hyphen before the id, with the id ending the line, is not a match
c-short-id: left edge contrast, a hyphen joined to a lower-case letter is not a run, so it matches
c-short-id: punctuation after the id is a boundary, so it matches
d-corpus: a corpus id that is not private and not shipped stays matched
d-corpus: a letter after the id extends the word, so no match
